name: Skyknight Squire, Hero of Bretagard, Ezio — 'it has <keyword> and is a <type> in addition to its other types' grants the keyword
notes: 'As long as this creature has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and is a Knight in addition to its other types': the add-type parser claimed the sentence and emitted only the Knight, so the keyword in front of 'and is' was lost. Squire has three counters (flying, Knight). Hero of Bretagard has five: flying and Angel from its first sentence, but not indestructible or God, which need ten. Ezio has one counter, so neither first strike nor Assassin.
